assumptions: Atomic branch: Nonrelativistic isolated He with Z=2, an infinite-mass point nucleus and two opposite-spin electrons occupying the same spherical 1s spatial orbital.
Atomic branch: Normalize integral |u|^2 dr=1 and define p=2|u|^2=4 pi r^2 n, so integral p dr=2.
Atomic branch: For this occupied orbital only, the Fock equation reduces to the effective field -2/r+v_H/2 and E_x=-E_H/2; no general nonlocal Fock operator is implemented.
Atomic branch: Single-determinant exchange is included; electron correlation is omitted.
Separate molecular branch: H2 RHF in finite s-Gaussian spaces, analytic one-/two-electron integrals and matrix SCF; see the H2 input and measured checks for its own tolerances.
units: Atomic units (hbar=m_e=e=4 pi epsilon_0=1): r in bohr, energies/effective potentials in hartree, and normalized reduced orbitals u in bohr^(-1/2). Positive electron-number density n(r) is in bohr^(-3); radial number density p(r)=4 pi r^2 n(r) is in bohr^(-1), with integral p dr=N. p is not signed charge density. Molecular branch: normalized 3D AO functions in bohr^(-3/2); overlap, AO density matrix and electron count dimensionless; transformed Fock commutator in hartree. Molecular tolerances are stated separately.
boundary_conditions: Helium reduced orbital: u(0)=u(r_max)=0, baseline r_max=16 bohr with a separate 4/8/12/16-bohr domain study. The Hartree field is finite at the origin and joins N/r outside the density; it is not fixed to zero at r_max. Separate H2 branch: isolated molecule, analytic whole-space Gaussian integrals; no finite radial box.

next_deliverable.en: Maintain fixed inputs, saved references and release integrity for the existing small examples; rerun a few representative cases when needed. Large basis/k-point sweeps, expensive independent-reference regeneration and long BOMD/CPMD trajectories are considered separately only on explicit need.

limitations.ja: この局所交換の簡約を多軌道・開殻・分子・周期系へそのまま拡張できない。原子版ではUHF/ROHF・分子積分・軌道安定性解析を扱わない。保存PySCF RHF参照は独立な有限Gaussian基底計算であり、相関を含むHeの厳密エネルギーではない。格子・箱幅・SCF収束と物理モデル誤差を区別する。 H₂では別の分子積分実装を用いる。分子DFT・一般多中心分子・開殻・軌道安定性解析は未実装。
limitations.en: The local exchange reduction cannot be transferred unchanged to multi-orbital, open-shell, molecular or periodic systems. The atomic edition does not implement UHF/ROHF, molecular integrals or orbital-stability analysis. Saved PySCF RHF references are independent finite-Gaussian-basis calculations, not exact correlated helium energies. Separate grid, domain and SCF convergence from physical model error. H₂ uses a separate molecular-integral implementation. Molecular DFT, general multicenter molecules, open shells and orbital-stability analysis remain unimplemented.

assumptions_ja: 従来の原子例：Z=2の孤立He、無限質量の点核、非相対論。逆スピンの2電子が同じ球対称1s空間軌道を占有する。
従来の原子例：∫|u|²dr=1とし、p=2|u|²=4πr²n、∫p dr=2と定義する。
従来の原子例：この占有軌道に限り有効場は−2/r+v_H/2、交換エネルギーはE_x=−E_H/2に簡約される。一般の非局所Fock演算子は実装していない。
従来の原子例：単一行列式の交換を含み、電子相関を含まない。
別の分子例：H₂の有限s型Gaussian基底RHF。自作の1・2電子積分と行列SCFを用い、公差・収束はH₂入力と検証結果で確認する。
units_ja: 原子単位系（ℏ=mₑ=e=4πε₀=1）。rはbohr、エネルギー・有効ポテンシャルはhartree、規格化した縮約軌道uはbohr⁻¹ᐟ²。正の電子数密度n(r)はbohr⁻³、動径電子数密度p(r)=4πr²n(r)はbohr⁻¹、∫p dr=N。pは符号付き電荷密度ではありません。 分子側：3次元AOはbohr^(−3/2)で規格化。重なり行列・AO密度行列・電子数は無次元、直交化したFock交換子はhartree。分子側の公差は別に記載。
boundary_conditions_ja: He縮約軌道にu(0)=u(r_max)=0（基本r_max=16 bohr、別途4/8/12/16 bohrの領域検査）。Hartree場は原点で有限、密度の外ではN/rへ接続し、r_maxで0には固定しません。 別のH₂側は孤立分子の全空間Gaussian解析積分で、有限の動径箱は設けない。

caution.ja: HFの解は一般に一意とは限りません。SCFが停止しても基底収束・軌道安定性・正しい電子状態の確認が必要です。分子解離では単一参照の限界が現れます。
caution.en: HF solutions need not be unique. SCF termination does not prove basis convergence, orbital stability or the desired electronic state. Bond dissociation can expose single-reference limitations.

name.en: A tiny three-center H3+ RHF / MP2 / FCI example

caption.ja: 固定三角形H3+の3中心小分子で、RHF/MP2/有限基底FCIを示します。 独立な演算子組立と2電子RS2恒等式で固定小模型を照合します。新しい外部PySCF参照はありません。一般分子DFT、CC、多参照法、精密エネルギー・最適化・化学精度は未実装/未検証。MP2は変分上界ではありません。
caption.en: Demonstrate RHF, MP2 and finite-basis FCI for a tiny fixed three-center H3+ molecule. Independent operator assembly and two-electron RS2 identity qualify this fixed toy. No fresh external PySCF scalar. General molecular DFT, CC, multireference methods, precision energetics, geometry optimization and chemical accuracy remain unimplemented/unverified. MP2 is not variational.
